title: 한글 졸업: 소리 규칙 최종 점검
objective: Read everyday Korean words aloud using these four sound rules.
summary: A final review of four Hangul sound rules.

task.title: Read and write the sound
task.line: Say each word aloud first, then choose or write how it really sounds.

words.exampleMeaning: I go to school in the morning.

letters.as: Linking: a final consonant moves to a following ㅇ.
Nasal sounds: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ before ㄴ or ㅁ become ㅇ, ㄴ, ㅁ.
ㅎ rule: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ, ㅈ + ㅎ, or ㅎ + ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅈ, become ㅋ, ㅌ, ㅍ, ㅊ. A final ㅎ before a vowel is silent (많아요 [마나요]).
Tense sounds: after ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ, the next ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ, ㅅ, ㅈ become tense.

exercises: Linking: choose the real sound. ① 한국어 [한구거 / 한국어] ② 일요일 [이료일 / 일요일]
Nasal sounds: write the real sound in [ ]. ① 입니다 → [ ] ② 작년 → [ ]
The ㅎ rule: write the real sound in [ ]. ① 많아요 → [ ] ② 입학 → [ ]
Tense sounds: does the second syllable start with a tense sound (ㄲ, ㄸ, ㅃ, ㅆ, ㅉ)? Write Yes or No. ① 식당 ② 어머니
